text:
Mike (Sales): ACME flagged a regression in embeddings + rerank after last week's model push. They sent 12 failing queries and examples. They're asking for timeline to fix, escalated from their CSM.
Jana (CS): adding their notes — top issues: relevant doc drops from p@1 to p@5, some duplicates promoted, and tail-case latency spikes. They say it started ~2026-02-18 09:00 UTC.
Anya (PM): thanks. We need to triage: repro set, exact model/version, config (quant, batch), and concrete metric deltas. Can CS attach the sample CSV and expected vs actual ranks?
Mike (Sales): uploaded CSV to the case: https://acme-support/CASE-789. Customer wants either a rollback toggle or a config we can apply now.
Ramon (Eng-ML): pinged. What's the serving model id and runtime image? Any recent reranker weight changes? Also need the eval harness output (p@1, recall@10 before/after).
Tara (Eng Runtime): we rolled model redwood-embed-v2 -> v2.1 last Thursday and also flipped KV-cache prefetch to aggressive mode for higher throughput. That could change prefix caching behavior. Could be interaction.
Jana (CS): customer said they saw the worst drops for short queries (2–4 tokens) and named-entity queries. Latency went from 120ms median to 240ms p50 for their tenant.
Anya (PM): draft triage plan: (1) reproduce offline with their 12 + a 1000-query sampled set, (2) measure p@1/p@5/recall@10 and latency distribution, (3) attempt quick config rollback (KV-cache mode) as mitigation, (4) if repro confirmed, schedule fix. Acceptance criteria for closure: p@1 within 5% of baseline AND latency p50 < 150ms for their workload. Agree?
Ramon (Eng-ML): estimate: 1 day to reproduce and gather metrics if we get the sample set and model artifact; 2–5 days to root-cause and test a model/config patch; 1 week for canary + rollout. If it's a runtime cache interaction, fix could be config-only (faster).
Tara (Eng Runtime): we can toggle KV-cache back to conservative quickly at infra level and can pin their tenant to the previous runtime image for isolation — needs ProdOps approval but doable.
Mike (Sales): customer asked for ETA this morning. If we can offer tenant pinning + short rollback, they'll wait 48–72hrs. I'll propose that.
Jana (CS): I'll ask ACME to provide the 1000-sample workload and the exact timestamps of failing requests. Also asking for two golden examples we can use in E2E checks.
Anya (PM): priority: mark as P1 for enterprise SLA; create product-backlog item with scope: repro, mitigation, root-cause, fix, and postmortem. Owners: Ramon (Eng-ML) + Tara (Eng Runtime) + Jana (CS) for verification.
Ramon (Eng-ML): assign me provisional owner. Need the model hash (SHA) and serving config. Also request logs for reranker scoring — paste sample log lines if possible.
Jana (CS): case note updated with logs and model id: redwood/emb-rank@sha256:3b9f... Attached small log excerpt:
```
[2026-02-18T09:12:03Z] tenant=acme req=ae3f score_top1=0.42 score_expected=0.81 latency_ms=312
[2026-02-18T09:12:05Z] tenant=acme req=bb7c score_top1=0.39 score_expected=0.77 latency_ms=298
```
Anya (PM): good. Next steps for product backlog: add launch criteria for any reranker change: must include regression eval set from top-5 customers, p@1 baseline check, and latency SLO tests. I'll draft a short spec.
Tara (Eng Runtime): note: if we pin tenant to previous image we should monitor capacity — pinging ProdOps.
deploy-bot: Deployment redwood-embed-v2.1 -> prod completed 2026-02-18T02:47:12Z.
Mike (Sales): 👍 I'll tell ACME we can try tenant pin + toggle KV-cache and will follow up in 2 business days.
Anya (PM): Action items: Jana to collect expanded repro set (due EOD), Ramon to run offline eval (ETA 24h after data), Tara to prepare tenant pin playbook (ETA 12h), Anya to create backlog ticket and add acceptance criteria.
Jana (CS): on it — filing the 1000-sample bundle now.
Ramon (Eng-ML): starting repro run when bundle arrives. Will post results here.
Anya (PM): thanks team. We'll update roadmap backlog with a cross-team epic and label as "customer-urgent: rerank regression". :thumbsup:
Mike (Sales): case #CASE-789 updated with proposed mitigation. Customer awaits confirmation.
Jana (CS): will verify mitigation works end-to-end once toggle applied.
Ramon (Eng-ML): preliminary repro looks promising — early p@1 delta confirmed. Sharing numbers shortly.
Tara (Eng Runtime): ProdOps approved tenant pin for ACME for 72hrs. I'll schedule the pin for 2pm UTC.
Anya (PM): closing loop later today with owners; if no blocker we'll keep this as high-priority roadmap work for next sprint and aim to ship a robust fix in 2 sprints if root cause requires model retraining.
Mike (Sales): thanks everyone. I'll push the communication to ACME and keep the pressure low. :handshake:
